title_zh: 政策与企业发展产业测试验证场
author: 许丙南
boundary_note: These are three bounded validation scenarios for enterprise and public-service development. They are not procurement approvals, public deployments, investment commitments or evidence of local company performance.

cases.name_zh: 模型安全与透明度验证窗
cases.location: 众智园 AI 自主创新加速区 / booked test room
cases.enterprise_question: Can a startup or supplier show repeatable safety, data provenance, human review and rollback evidence before a public-sector pilot expands?
cases.policy_interface: Pre-procurement assurance record: purpose, model/data boundary, red-team result, accountable reviewer, non-AI alternative and stop decision.
cases.acceptance_test: Two independent reviewers can reproduce the declared test note; a failed gate blocks the token and publishes a plain-language reason.
cases.stop_condition: unknown data rights, missing human reviewer or failed takeover drill
cases.non_ai_equivalent: paper test protocol plus expert review

cases.name_zh: 企业服务与数据要素合规验证窗
cases.location: AI 原点社区 / 大钟寺企业服务节点
cases.enterprise_question: Can an enterprise-service team shorten a public process without exposing unauthorised data or turning an AI answer into a binding administrative decision?
cases.policy_interface: Service preflight record: public source, authorised document set, human decision owner, correction path, retention period and manual counter-equivalent.
cases.acceptance_test: A test user completes the same process through AI-assisted and manual routes; every material answer has a source and a named human correction route.
cases.stop_condition: unverifiable document, personal-information spill, discriminatory routing or missing manual counter
cases.non_ai_equivalent: 人工企业服务柜台、纸面流程和现场咨询

cases.name_zh: 低速具身智能安全与运营验证窗
cases.location: 众智园—京张公园慢行界面 / bounded low-speed window
cases.enterprise_question: Can a robot or embodied-AI supplier demonstrate safe coexistence with an accessible public route before any scale-up or procurement decision?
cases.policy_interface: Public test permit package: route map, speed/priority rule, emergency stop, human takeover, incident log, privacy boundary, maintenance owner and withdrawal trigger.
cases.acceptance_test: A staffed drill demonstrates stop, manual takeover, route clearance and return to ordinary public use; no robot occupies the accessible chain.
cases.stop_condition: failed emergency stop, blocked accessible chain, severe near miss or maintenance lapse
cases.non_ai_equivalent: 人工配送、人工引导和静态导视
